pack: B3 HD strategic bombers, generic air-dropped weapons and squadron power icons
pipeline: tools/art/airkit_hd.py (new shared HD kit) on top of tools/art/airkit.py + tools/art/veh_m88_3d.py (library halves, unchanged); measured outline frames imported read-only from tools/art/air_b52_3d.py, air_b1_3d.py, air_b2_3d.py
command: python3 -I tools/art/air_b52_hd.py --no-sheet; python3 -I tools/art/air_b1_hd.py --no-sheet; python3 -I tools/art/air_b2_hd.py --no-sheet; python3 -I tools/art/wpn_bombs_hd.py; python3 -I tools/art/icons_bomber_powers.py; python3 -I tools/art/sheet_bombers_hd.py
method: Code-placed lofts and primitives in Blender 5.2 (bpy module). Outer lines (fuselage side/top profiles, wing / tail planforms, B-2 planform and centre-body profile) re-lofted at higher density from the M3 measured frames; all detail geometry (bay cut-outs, bay interiors, clamshell doors, B-1 pivoting outer wings, glazing, intakes, nozzles, pylons, racks, tanks, antennas) is new procedural code. One Smart-UV atlas per aircraft packed with concave island packing. Textures are fully procedural numpy paint evaluated per texel from its 3D position and normal (base paint, per-panel tone, panel lines, rivet rows, control-surface gaps, flow streaks, exhaust soot, leading-edge wear, low-visibility insignia) with a Cycles CPU AO bake (2048 px) multiplied into the albedo. Normal map derived from a procedural height field in UV space; roughness / metal packed as glTF metallicRoughness (G = roughness, B = metallic, R = AO for reference only). No concept-image projection, no photo or scan textures, no AI image generation.
license: original work, project-owned (code-generated geometry and textures)
content_notes: Fictional game equipment. The three bombers depict the general configuration of real aircraft types (eight-engine swept-wing bomber, swing-wing bomber, flying wing) and carry a low-visibility star-and-bar style roundel painted procedurally; real type names appear in the game UI. Same release-review flag as the M3 aircraft (docs/ASSET_MANIFEST_AIRCRAFT.md): confirm names / insignia / likeness before publication. Bombs are generic shapes with no markings or text.
conventions: 1 unit = 1 m, real size (UnitDefs.SCALE.bomber = 1.0); forward = Godot -Z; origin under the fuselage midpoint at gear-retracted belly level. Nodes: mesh 'Body' (atlas material + SA_Team + SA_Glass), doors 'Door<bay>L' / 'Door<bay>R' (origin on the hinge line; open by rotating about local Z: L negative, R positive), B-1 'WingL' / 'WingR' (origin on the pivot; sweep about local Y: L positive, R negative), B-52 'StoresL' / 'StoresR' (modelled pylon-rack bombs, hidden when the game stages individual bombs), empties 'Exhaust<n>', 'Bay<i>a' / 'Bay<i>b' (fore / aft end of bay i's stowed-weapon line), 'PB<n>' (B-52 pylon bomb stations).
